title: dahlia purpurea var. rubra
intro: Dahlia purpurea var. rubra, commonly known as red dahlia, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Asteraceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions. The plant is believed to have health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving digestion, likely due to its therapeutic actions, which may include anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents of red dahlia, including flavonoids, glycosides, and saponins, are thought to be responsible for its medicinal effects, although further research is needed to confirm its uses and efficacy.
